reviews.text: Very helpful

Dr. Callahan and Lakeiaria were very helpful and transparent about what the cost for procedures and medications would be and what the procedures they wanted to perform were and they were very attentive to my pets needs and his ailments. They were also very kind and gentle with him and explained everything with a lot of detail and more than once made sure I didn't have any questions or was unclear about anything . Thay were just AWESOME!!!

I had to take my cat in, and the staff was quick, attentive, friendly and very helpful. I was seen quickly, the assistant was very kind, helpful and knew how to handle stressed out cats. The doctor was very nice, friendly and knowledgeable, and soon we were on our way back home. It was a very positive experience, and I will continue supporting this high-quality veterinarian establishment.
I’m happy with Modern Animal. Dr. Callahan is extremely thorough and compassionate.
Modern Animal is excellent! They took their time and I didn’t feel rushed. My pup loved the treats and felt right at home.

The ladies at modern animal are amazing the doctor is very knowledgeable very professional and kept me in the loop in regards to female Chihuahua pregnancies I brought my dad in doctor was able to after a brief exam tell me with 95% accuracy win my dog was going to have the babies thank you doctor and staff for all your help much appreciated okay
Great place
Thanks for the 5-star review!  We appreciate you!
We had such a good experience with them for our kitty. Reasonably priced and we will definitely be using modern vet as our vet from now on! Chicken loves his tennis ball!
First time visit - I was in a rush, chose the closest vet, they fit me in late in the day, and they were awesome. Thank you!
I was given a complete hustle script and a 3k bill just for a first time visit for a co up and told my dog would have to be put to sleep in order to get help.i had a complete musel on her mouth.smdh
Monica was pertinent and polite. Obviously a very caring a patient person. I'm happy to have you guys as my pets primary vet!

I have a six-year-old dog That has been going to the vet since I’ve had her at 8 weeks and this has been the worst vet we have been to. The first time I brought her in, The vet assistant seemed as if she had never been to school or knows anything. She told me things needed prescription when in fact, they didn’t and the things that did need prescription. She didn’t provide me with. I asked multiple times for a heartworm test which wasn’t completed so I was not able to get heartworm prevention medication As the vet assistant insisted, I did not need a prescription. They also said that they were unable to trim my dog nails due to her temperament (again she’s 6 years old and gets them trimmed every other month). They asked me to bring her back under a calming medication. I was told this calming medication was ready for pick up, but when I got to them, they had no idea what I was talking about and asked me to come back in two days as they were not open the next day (already a 20 minute drive for me one way) but I had a message in writing that her prescription was ready. When it came to her rescheduled appointment, I decided to not even put myself or my dog through the stress again For them to possibly do the same thing again. They charge me $50 for a “missed” appointment But did not mention anything about being charged when I told them about my situation and why I was not going to bring my dog in. I understand this place is new, but they need to figure out their bumps before they take patients. I only had issues with this place. They do not value communication and the fact that they thought it was OK to charge me is insane. I would stay very far away from this as there’s many others.
Thanks so much for the 5-star review!  We appreciate you!

This is our new Vet Clinic!

We took my senior dog in after he was having some GI issues and everyone we worked with was extremely professional and caring.

Monica was our Tech., she was very thorough and asked several questions to help gather all the information that Dr. Callahan would need to help determine the best course of action for our pup.

Dr. Callahan was very helpful , she made recommendations for Marvel's diet to help add a food that has Probiotics to help with his tummy. Dr. C had us do a full Senior Blood Panel to help rule out any infections etc. She found an ear infection and did an on site cytology and gave us a medication to help clear the infection.

Everyone at this clinic cares about your pet as much as you do
and it shows. We found our new Clinic!!

Thank you, Dr. Callahan and everyone at Modern Animal!!

Caramelo has found a vet that he really loves. As a dog mom taking him to the vet is always nerve racking but the team was amazing from the moment we walked into the clinic we were greeted nicely and had a good feeling we were in good hands. They were very thoughtful and amazing for our first time there. We appreciate the whole staff for easing our anxiety. They were truly amazing!! Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a caring vet.

I used Modern Vet in Houston, TX and after relocating to Scottsdale, I brought my Italian greyhound in for a nail trim and couldn't have asked for a better experience. The tech was incredibly gentle and patient with him. Italian greyhounds can be nervous and sensitive, especially with their paws, but she handled him with so much care. She took her time and did a thorough, precise job on his nails without rushing or stressing him out.  I'm so grateful!  Thank you SO MUCH!

Dr Callahan was great! This was our 1st visit and my dog is very shy around people. She took ample time and offered treats to make her as comfortable as possible. She explained everything in detail, answered all my questions and concerns and proposed several treatment options at various price points. I will definitely bring my other dog and cat here in the future. Thank you Melody and Dr Callahan!
Thank you for the 5-star review, Ashley!

They were very kind & professional!!
My dog Lucy & my cat ChaCha got along with them!!

10/10 recommend! Took my oldest cat here and I was thoroughly explained what could be causing her weight loss with a few treatment options! Dr. Callahan was extremely helpful and very down to earth! They fed Smokey treats when she was getting assessed and made her feel comfortable! Will be taking all my animals here in the future! They even provide cold beverages in the waiting area!
Great first visit at this clinic and with Dr Callahan. She addressed all our concerns, helped create a plan for my pup that was right for us.  Thank you!

The staff is very friendly and helpful. The doctor is very attentive, knowledgeable and clearly explains everything. Including a plan on how to fix my dogs ear infections so that he doesn't continue getting them. My poor pup has had at least six ear infections this year. Where I was taking him before they would just treat him and send me home. Where I was taking him before, there was never an explanation of the possible causes of the ear infections. Along with here's what we can do to try to prevent these. At Modern Animal, I am now getting that. And my dog is doing better and feeling so much better.

Highly recommend! Everyone was very welcoming and friendly. Both the vet and the vet tech were phenomenal. They’re extremely knowledgeable - provided insight into everything they were doing / finding. They answered all of my questions thoroughly and never made me feel rushed. Will absolutely be transferring my other pet’s care here as well!

I had a great experience here and so did my cat Georgie ! Dr Noelle Callahan was wonderful to work with, super knowledgeable and took her time explaining everything I needed to know about my new cat! The staff was very nice and had treats to make Georgie feel at home… and I loved that they had a fridge with water and coffee to help the humans feel at home!

Absolutely love Dr. Noelle Callahan. She’s professional, friendly, extremely knowledgeable, honest, cool,, trustworthy - basically all the things you want in a Vet! So happy I’ve found an amazing vet who’s close to my house. Thank you Dr. Callahan and your 2 awesome vet techs!
The staff was friendly and made sure my skittish dog felt comfortable through the whole appointment. Can’t recommend enough!
Love Love Modern Animal & so happy to have a clinic here in Phx for my pets ! 10/10 service 🩵 …
